productDetails:
Large, soft, slouchy leather top-handle bag with a fold-over flap, belted warm-gold closure, two upright rolled handles and a detachable shoulder strap. Intended material specification: vegetable-tanned leather; factory must confirm leather type, grade, thickness and tanning documentation. Natural grain and matte-to-satin body finish with smoother trim. Preserve braided upper-edge trim, lower corner caps, horizontal oval center plate, paired flat-bar side fittings, key bell and inward-draping belt tails. No logos or third-party branding.

Four colorways: Chocolate (dark body with warmer cognac contrast trim), Cognac, Black and Olive. Chocolate is the approved design master. Final Black/Olive trim and all factory color swatches require approval.

Nominal design dimensions: 38 cm top width x 27 cm body height x 20 cm depth; 10 cm handle drop; detachable strap target 100-115 cm adjustable. These are owner-approved design targets, NOT physical sample measurements. Factory must supply a dimensioned drawing and measured first article. Interior, lining, pockets, base construction, exact closure assembly and usable capacity require sample confirmation. No laptop-fit claim is established.

Positioning: understated everyday luxury, tactile leather, relaxed silhouette, distinctive warm-gold detailing and versatile hand/forearm/long-strap carry. Currently offered on preorder; public product page states expected October shipping. This is not confirmation of factory readiness or manufacturing lead time.
whatImprovements:
Develop a production-ready version faithful to the approved Vivienne design. Priorities:
1. Measured first-article approval against the dimensional drawing; dimensional checks in every pre-shipment inspection.
2. Confirm leather composition, grade, thickness and tanning method with swatches and documentation. Preserve the soft slouch and the contrast between body grain and smoother trim; no material substitutions without approval.
3. Reinforce handle roots and shoulder-strap attachments without stiffening the body. Handles must retain their upright rounded shape. Provide tested load limits and durability results.
4. Consistent stitching and braided trim; neatly finished and edge-painted leather; durable low-odor adhesives; check dye transfer against light clothing.
5. Match approved warm-gold hardware and closure geometry. Confirm operating mechanism on a physical sample; quote corrosion resistance and closure-cycle testing. No extra logos, padlocks or hardware.
6. Propose and quote lining and practical interior pockets separately for approval; they are not verified existing features. Confirm rear/base construction and strap clips on the sample.
7. Supply color swatches and a pre-production sample for approval, plus a documented pre-shipment inspection. Quote an unbranded natural cotton dust bag and protective recycled-kraft shipping packaging separately.

Please quote 2,500 units total. Color split is to be confirmed. Production remains subject to quotation and sample approval.
